ShortDescription.Value: Let multiple buses board and unload together at the same stop, with automatic and editable boarding zones.

Publish.LongDescription:
Concurrent Bus Boarding lets several buses use the same stop at the same time when there is enough road space. The stop is the forward edge of the boarding zone, buses queue naturally behind it, board and unload concurrently, then continue to their next stop when finished.
FEATURES
- Optional: up to two buses board together at ordinary curbside stops. Switch it on in Options; it is off by default because a longer stop can make residents less likely to choose that line. - Pull-in bays use their full detected lane and fit as many buses as their usable length allows. - Buses keep their natural traffic spacing and remain stopped once boarding starts, even when the bus ahead leaves. - Waiting passengers are offered to active buses in round-robin order while the game keeps its normal route, fare, animation, and capacity checks. - Every served bus stop has a length control plus draggable rear-edge map handles for resizing its boarding zone. - Per-stop edits save with the city and can be reset to automatic detection at any time. - Boarding-zone overlays use each stop's line colour by default, with custom stop and whole-line colour wheels. - Options provides a global fallback colour and opacity control shared by every overlay colour source. - Options includes a confirmed action that resets every customized zone in the current city. - Boarding-zone overlays show only for the selected stop by default; this can be changed in Options. - Options includes a 50-200% public transport attractiveness slider. The 100% default preserves vanilla passenger-route costs; higher values make passenger public transport more attractive. - Options includes a 100-200% extra bus attractiveness slider, defaulting to 150%, that makes residents prefer buses specifically. It affects only route costs used exclusively by bus lines, so other transport types keep their normal costs. - Options includes a confirmed action that clears stuck boarding state from a city saved with an earlier version.
HOW TO EDIT A STOP
Select a served bus stop and open Bus Boarding Zone. Use Length for precise adjustment, or choose Edit on map and drag either cyan rear corner. The stop remains the fixed forward edge. Right-click or press Escape when finished.
SCOPE AND COMPATIBILITY
Boarding behavior changes only passenger buses. The optional attractiveness setting applies to every passenger public transport type; cargo transport keeps its normal route costs. This is a code mod that integrates with the game's vehicle, passenger, and pathfinding ECS systems; it may require an update after a major game patch.

ChangeLog.Value: Fixes a critical simulation error introduced in 1.5.0: the stuck-stop repair and the line report ran in the wrong update phase and changed entities mid-simulation. Concurrent boarding is now off by default and must be switched on in Options. A bus held at a stop takes a little longer than the game's own boarding, and the game uses stop waiting times when residents choose a route, so on a busy network it can cost passengers. Updating from an earlier version switches it off once even if it was previously on; turn it back on in Options if you want it. The overlays, per-stop zone editor and stuck-stop repair work either way. Also includes the 1.5.0 fixes: bus lines steadily losing their passengers over a long session. A stop could stay reserved for a bus that had already moved on, and the game will not start boarding at a reserved stop, so lines died stop by stop; stops reserved by a vehicle that is no longer there are now released continuously. Buses no longer sit at a stop far longer than the game intends, and no longer leave before waiting passengers have been let on. Concurrent boarding now engages only when two or more buses are actually at the same stop, so a bus alone at its stop is left entirely to the game, and it can be switched off in Options at any time. Adds an optional bus attractiveness slider that makes residents prefer buses specifically, and an Options action, also run automatically on load, that clears stuck boarding state from cities saved with an earlier version. With thanks to CheeseBunny_Gaming, Eiden3000 and Minimumderp for reporting the problem and helping track it down.
